name: Honolulu Hoʻoilo 2025
information: ### Speedcubing returns to O'ahu with another WCA competition! * It is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot. * Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first official competition, [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8) will provide you with most of the information you need. * If you are a first time competitor it is highly encouraged to be present for the competitor tutorial at 8:45 AM. ![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b5378e_88f526a00b5e4d6391ec03e6ea67452c~mv2.png/v1/fit/w_2500,h_1330,al_c/b5378e_88f526a00b5e4d6391ec03e6ea67452c~mv2.png) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NDEyMDQsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--0b99e99509c89cea2820bba86fda59bce7b81497/scswcc5.png) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NDEyMDMsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--918dbe0f113bd4f4b036d82afff9488aacb1d752/Diansheng%20logo%20-%201.png) #### We would like to thank Diansheng and SpeedCubeShop for being our official sponsors for this competition!
